text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking a walk in the central plaza during a break—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Besides eating chanko nabe, what else is there...
Ah, I know!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Dangling from the horizontal bar, having someone pull my legs real tight, stuff like that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, not bad at all!
Now all that's left is~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer! Perfect timing~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Actually, you see...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Bono!!
What do I gotta do to get big?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh my~. What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a strong, cool hero!
And to do that, I've gotta grow bigger!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll endure any harsh training you throw at me...
So please, show me the way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's obviously eating a ton of food!
Nothing beats that! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I already do that! I always make sure
to eat everything I put on my plate!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"But I haven't gotten any bigger at all...
Isn't there any other way!?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And that's why!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking about all sorts of things,
and I ended up feeling like, "Ooh, that's nice~
and this is nice too~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, what kind of method
do you think would be best!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just being big doesn't necessarily make you
cool or strong, does it?
What a truly strong hero needs is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What should be made larger isn't your body,
but your heart, your breadth of mind..."
—or so I wanted to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see! It's not just about eating,
it's about overcoming our picky eating too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, you really only ever put the things you like on your plate~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, celery, bell peppers, parsley...
Yep! I'm gonna make even the stuff I hate taste delicious!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spread out over a cloth on the rooftop:
celery tempura, stuffed bell peppers—
a whole spread of diverse dishes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer taught me~!
The most important thing for a hero is tolerance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I didn't be picky with my food either,
and look how big I grew!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuu...!
It smells good, but... but...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Guh!! Man, the path to becoming a hero really is steep...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aha. Dosukoi, do your best~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Next to a resolute Biko Pegasus,
Hishi Akebono beamed, saying,
"My repertoire just grew!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see, mental strength...
But how do you train something like that?
choice_data_list: Maybe learn about having a never-give-up heart or something?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
An unyielding spirit...!!
If that's it, then maybe I can understand too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sumo wrestlers don't give up until the very end,
even when it's tough. No matter what's right before them—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Even if the chanko nabe is huge!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Basically, it means even if it's tough, you don't give up
and finish every last bite, right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I can help you out with that, then.
Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spread out over a cloth on the rooftop
is an absurd amount of food,
as if prepared for a massive banquet...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
To become a hero, you can't give up!
There's still plenty left, so eat every last bite!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: E-Eek...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alright then, thanks for the food—☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Telling her that eating such an absurd amount was out of the question, I invited the other Umamusume over, and we all enjoyed a fun meal together.
